scope: Focused inline editing of text sources in Library

checks: imported Markdown note opens directly in editable document
title and body autosave and survive full page reload
library row uses the edited title and reopens the same source route
Original & annotations retains original text and tools
routine backup reminder absent in open document
mobile file explorer starts collapsed for selected document
keyboard Tab moves from title to formatting controls
no horizontal overflow at either viewport
compact document bar measured 54px at desktop viewport

dataBehavior: First edit creates one linked local working document; imported originals and existing annotations remain unchanged. External Obsidian files are not rewritten. PDF and explicitly cited historical source versions use the original reader.
